audit.whatIsWrong: phases[].side read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Ekko/Skill/Skill while content win[] and the packet chart both read Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Skill/Neeko/Ekko/Ekko. Level 6 contradicted itself: side Ekko, why describing Neeko's Pop Blossom winning, win[4] Neeko.
audit.why: Ekko has no escape until Phase Dive at level 3 and is mana-hungry, so the first levels are Neeko's. Levels 4-5 even out on where Parallel Convergence is placed. Level 6 favours Neeko because Chronobreak is a defensive rewind, not an engage. Past first item his W-stun combo plus a heal-back ult wins extended fights.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-2 Neeko, row 3 Skill (unchanged), row 4 Neeko, rows 5-6 Ekko; whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes was the generic Level 3 / level 6 / Luden's line and never named his spike.
audit.why: His spike is items plus the full W-stun rotation with Chronobreak refunding the damage; that is what flips the lane at first item.
audit.corrected: Level 3 root-bloom is the kill pattern; level 6 still yours; his items plus Chronobreak flip it.

audit.whatIsWrong: All four flagged interactions were absent or vague: Chronobreak's untargetability, its heal, Parallel Convergence's shield, and the Phase Dive auto-reset tell. breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (defect item 3), and dosFull[2].d invented a "fifteen-second invitation" (defect item 6 — magnitude with no source).
audit.why: From the kits: Chronobreak is 110/80/50, makes him untargetable, and heals a percentage of the damage received in the rewound window — so damage spent into it is refunded twice over. Parallel Convergence is 22/20/18/16/14 at 1600 range, shields him and stuns anyone in the anomaly he enters. Phase Dive is a 325-range dash on 9/8.5/8/7.5/7 that resets his attack, which is the wind-up tell. Nothing in the kit supports a 15-second figure.
audit.corrected: Chronobreak is 110s at rank 1 and 50s at rank 3, untargetable and healing — hold your last damage until he lands; force Parallel Convergence out before committing; the Phase Dive wind-up is the cue to step back.
sources: enemyKit Q/W/E/R cooldowns, ranges and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldowns field had no numbers and told the reader to "count it out loud" without saying what to count to.
audit.why: Chronobreak's cooldown is the whole lane clock and it drops from 110s to 50s across its ranks — that change is what makes late duels unwinnable.
audit.corrected: Real numbers added for Chronobreak, Parallel Convergence and Phase Dive.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentioned anti-heal despite Chronobreak healing off the damage you deal.
audit.why: The missing-interactions file flags needs-antiheal on Chronobreak; the heal scales with damage received in the rewound window.
audit.corrected: Oblivion Orb named in breakdown.feeding so Chronobreak refunds less.

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed (defect item 2): dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim, dontsFull[1].d was the generic clone paragraph under a title about shoving past river, and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim.
audit.why: Titles promised clone play, river shoving and half-HP greed; the bodies explained something else.
audit.corrected: All three replaced with Ekko-grounded content matching their titles.
